notes: Hand positions are fractions of arm length, measured from the chest. across is out to the side, up is above the chest, ahead is in front. 1.0 ahead is a fully straight arm reaching forward.

keys.name: ready
keys.note: Arms already almost straight in front. This is the manual's distinguishing instruction for this catch.

keys.name: contact
keys.note: Takes the ball with arms almost straight, at chest height. Fingers up, thumbs in the middle.

keys.name: pull_in
keys.note: As soon as the ball is caught it comes in to the chest.

keys.name: release
keys.note: The momentum of the catch carries straight into the pass back.
